Commit: 37ec57e0dd7ae91c22225bc36bf5cd210ff9cba7
Only the gesture engine/interceptor and their dependencies are included.
Local patch: Swift/SwitchEngine.swift supports canceling queued ramps and asynchronously
draining an active gesture before display changes/module shutdown. Its phase-posting
closure is injectable for tests.
Local patch: CStrafe/CStrafe.c always attempts the instant gesture's ended phase
after a successful began, including when changed fails. Any phase failure still
returns false; this does not acknowledge OS delivery. Public ABI and payload
properties are unchanged. The interceptor remains upstream.
